source_facts: forkStub invokes native SYS_CLONE without a new exec to create stub TGIDs; the parent subsequently unmaps high address ranges in the stub.
newSubprocess calls unmap; unmap removes non-stub address ranges. Thus a native systrap stub need not retain a usable original argv memory range.

The current C23 observer insists on nonempty NUL-terminated cmdline for every inventoried native PID before choosing the two core actors; it also classifies any runsc-sandbox argv0 as another Sentry and rejects duplicate core roles.
